svg.text: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया । मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
daivī hy eṣā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā / mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te
This divine illusory energy made of the modes is hard to overcome — but those who surrender to the Lord cross beyond it.
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
